description: Share splits applied by forward adjustment to partition runs of the canonical minute data (src/lib/corporateActions.ts). effectiveDate is the first session trading split-adjusted; ratio is new shares per old share. Each is checked against the raw data's overnight move by `npm run market-events -- verify`.

splits.source: Vanguard press release 'Vanguard Announces Share Splits for Five Equity Index ETFs', 2026-03-24 (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vanguard-announces-share-splits-for-five-equity-index-etfs-302723368.html): VGT 8:1, record date 2026-04-17, payable 2026-04-20 after the close, split-adjusted trading from 2026-04-21; retrieved 2026-10-24
